questions.text: In C programming, what is the result of dereferencing an uninitialized or NULL pointer at runtime?

options.label: B
options.text: Undefined Behavior / Segmentation Fault at runtime

options.label: C
options.text: Automatically allocates heap memory via malloc()

options.label: D
options.text: Converts the pointer to a void* reference

questions.explanation: Dereferencing a NULL or wild pointer causes Undefined Behavior (typically a Segmentation Fault at runtime).

questions.text: Explain how dynamic memory allocation (malloc, calloc, realloc, and free) and pointer arithmetic work in C with an example.
questions.sampleRubric: 10 marks for comparing malloc/calloc/realloc/free; 10 marks for valid C pointer syntax example.

questions.text: Move All Zeros to the End: Write a C program that reads an integer N followed by N space-separated integers and moves all zeros to the end of the array while maintaining the relative order of non-zero elements.
questions.inputFormat: First line: integer N (size of array). Second line: N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: N space-separated integers with all zeros moved to the end while preserving non-zero order.

questions.text: Check Whether Two Strings Are Anagrams: Write a C program to check whether two given strings are anagrams of each other (case-insensitive) and print "Anagram" or "Not Anagram".
questions.inputFormat: Two whitespace-separated strings S1 and S2 on standard input.
questions.outputFormat: Print "Anagram" if S1 and S2 contain the exact same character frequencies (case-insensitive), otherwise print "Not Anagram".

questions.text: Rotate an Array by K Positions: Write a C program that reads an array of N integers and an integer K, right-rotates the array by K positions, and prints the rotated array.
questions.inputFormat: First line: integer N (size of array). Second line: N space-separated integers. Third line: integer K (number of right rotations).
questions.outputFormat: N space-separated integers representing the array after right rotation by K positions.
questions.constraints: Time Limit: 1.0s | Memory Limit: 64MB | 1 <= N <= 10^5, 0 <= K <= 10^9
